doc: The canonical schema of the worker native UI (the iii app's catalogue and wire protocol). Tags, codes and enum indexes are append-only: never renumber, never reuse. The ide repo keeps a byte-identical copy at native/catalog/catalog.json, checked by a unit test. Design: ide/projects/worker-native-ui/design.md sections 5 and 6.

encoding.doc: The schema: every message is one array of entries, each entry an array whose first element is its integer code. VM to host: the SDK calls __host_send(entries) with the array itself; on a device the VM encodes it in C as bin-v1 (design §5.8: a generic tagged JSON-value encoding with a per-message string table, header byte 0xB1). json-v0 is the text form of the same schema (UTF-8 JSON, no BOM, no trailing newline): the test harness, the conformance files and debugging use it. Host to VM: json-v0 text through __vm_receive(string).

valueTypes.dp: JSON number, density-independent pixels. For the common width and height props, -1 means fill the parent.
valueTypes.icon: JSON string: a Lucide icon name in kebab-case (globe, refresh-cw), one of the icons list (catalogue 3 and later). An unknown name draws a neutral square and logs once.
valueTypes.padding: JSON number (all sides) | [vertical, horizontal] | [top, end, bottom, start], in dp.
valueTypes.textWrite: [text: string, eventCount: int]: a script write into an uncontrolled text field. The host applies it only when eventCount equals its own count of user edits (and never during IME composition); otherwise it drops it.
valueTypes.enum: JSON integer: the index into the named list of enums. An out-of-range index reads as the prop's default.

binding.doc: Inside a List template subtree (List slots 1 to 4), any prop value may be the object {"$item": "field.path"}: the host reads that dotted path of the item the template is drawn for. A missing field reads as the prop's default. Bindings are not allowed outside a template (the host treats them as the default and logs once).

events.name: press
events.doc: A tap (or click, or Enter on a focused control).

events.name: longPress
events.doc: A long press, right-click or control-click. RemoteScreen sends [x, y] in page coordinates.

events.name: change
events.doc: Switch, Checkbox: [checked]. TextField: its edits arrive as text entries (host-to-VM code 4), not as events; subscribing to change turns them on.

events.name: submit
events.doc: TextField: the IME action or Enter, with the text at that moment.

events.name: select
events.doc: Segmented, Lanes: the option or lane chosen. Chart, Stat: the point the person let go on after a tap or a scrub. Steps: the step tapped. CodeView: [line], the line tapped, as numbered (from startLine). Waveform: [fraction], 0..1, where the person let go.

events.name: focus
events.doc: TextField gained (true) or lost (false) the focus.

events.name: dismiss
events.doc: Sheet closed by the person; ListDetail detail closed on compact (Back, the chevron, the side swipe).

events.name: endReached
events.doc: List: the last 5 items came into view (fires once per item count).

events.name: frame
events.doc: RemoteScreen: after every resize it applies (modeChanged = the resize's mode_changed), for the first frame after an activation (false), and when the page size of the frames changes (false, at most every 250 ms). Never per frame.

events.name: error
events.doc: RemoteScreen: the live view could not start, or stopped with an error.

events.name: keyboard
events.doc: RemoteScreen: the keyboard bar opened or closed by the person.

events.name: ready
events.doc: RemoteScreen: the first frame of the current session is on screen.

events.name: link
events.doc: Markdown: a link was tapped, with its destination as written (a bare URL the autolinker found, too). The host never opens it: the script decides (iii.openUrl, nav.push).

events.name: drop
events.doc: List with a dragGroup: an item was dropped on this List. key = the item's key field; index = where it goes among this List's items once it is out of its old place (0..count); source = the node id of the List it came from (this one for a reorder).

events.name: startReached
events.doc: List with anchor bottom: the first 5 items came into view (fires once per item count). Load older items and splice them in at index 0: the host keeps the items in view where they are.

commonProps.name: visible
commonProps.doc: False: the node takes no space and is not drawn.

commonProps.name: events
commonProps.doc: Bitmask of subscribed events, bit (1 << event tag). The host only sends subscribed events and only enables the gestures behind them (no long-press haptic without longPress).

commonProps.name: a11yLabel
commonProps.doc: Overrides what a screen reader says for the node.

commonProps.name: weight
commonProps.doc: In a Row or Column: share of the remaining space; 0 = none.

commonProps.name: width
commonProps.doc: null = the node's own size; -1 = fill the parent.

commonProps.name: height
commonProps.doc: null = the node's own size; -1 = fill the parent.

commonProps.name: alignSelf
commonProps.doc: Overrides the parent's cross-axis alignment for this child; null = the parent's.

props.name: maxLines
props.doc: 0 = unlimited.

props.name: hue
props.doc: Not none: this named color (the app's agent and project colors) instead of the tone.

props.name: hue
props.doc: Not none: this named color (the app's agent and project colors) instead of the variant.

props.name: hue
props.doc: Not none: this named color (the app's agent and project colors) instead of the tone.

props.name: value
props.doc: 0..1; null = indeterminate.

props.name: src
props.doc: A data URI (data:image/png|jpeg|webp;base64,...), at most limits.maxImageBytes decoded. Nothing else: no URLs.

props.name: text
props.doc: CommonMark with GFM tables, strikethrough and autolinks, drawn by the app's chat renderer. Past limits.maxMarkdownChars the host draws the start and a note. Images show as their alt text (the host fetches nothing); raw HTML shows as text.

props.name: dense
props.doc: The small type of a comment or a card; false = body.

props.name: label
props.doc: Required: what the button does, for screen readers and tests.

props.name: lines
props.doc: 1 = single line; more = multi-line with that many lines at least.

props.name: autocorrect
props.doc: Forced off for url, email and password keyboards.

props.name: hue
props.doc: Not none: this named color (the app's agent and project colors) instead of the tone.

props.name: text
props.doc: The label after the box; a tap on it toggles too.

props.name: indeterminate
props.doc: A dash instead of the check (some of a group are checked); a tap sends change [true].

props.name: strike
props.doc: While checked, the label is struck through and muted (a done to-do).

props.name: kindField
props.doc: Item field holding 0..3: which template slot (1 + kind) draws the item; null = always template 0.

props.name: dragGroup
props.doc: Not null: a long press lifts an item, and it can be dragged to any List with the same group (this one included: a reorder); releasing it fires drop on the List under it. A long press released without moving still fires the item's longPress. Inside Lanes, holding a dragged item over a tab (or near the side in columns) for 400 ms brings that lane; releasing it on a tab drops it at index 0 of the first List in that lane.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: bottom: the List opens at its end and stays there as items arrive while the person is at the end (a chat log, a feed of events); scrolled up, it stays put. startReached asks for older items.

props.name: tone
props.doc: Not default: the border and a faint fill in this tone (attention for a question waiting, danger for a failure, success, accent).

props.name: titles
props.doc: One per lane, in order.

props.name: counts
props.doc: Per lane, a short text after the title (a count: 5, 99+); null or a missing entry = none.

props.name: selected
props.doc: One lane per page: the lane in view. Columns: the lane the host scrolls into view when this changes.

props.name: laneWidth
props.doc: The width of a column. The host shows columns side by side when at least two fit its width (they share the width when all fit), else one lane per page under a tab strip.

props.name: name
props.doc: Whose avatar: the initials (the first letter of the first and of the last word, uppercased; one letter for one word) and, with hue none, the color. Also what a screen reader says.

props.name: image
props.doc: A data URI like Image.src, at most limits.maxImageBytes decoded; drawn instead of the initials, cropped to the shape.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Drawn instead of the initials when there is no image (bot for an agent).

props.name: hue
props.doc: none: picked from the name, hue index 1 + (the sum of its UTF-16 code units mod 6), so every host gives a name the same color; a neutral surface when the name is empty.

props.name: status
props.doc: Not null: a status dot of this tone at the bottom end, ringed in the background color.

props.name: at
props.doc: The moment, in epoch milliseconds; null draws nothing.

props.name: style
props.doc: relative: just now, 5 min ago, in 3 hours, yesterday, then the date past a week (the platform's relative formatter in env.locale). short: now, 5m, 3h, 2d, then the date. elapsed: the running duration since at (until at when it is ahead), 0:42, 4:05, 1:02:33. date, time, dateTime: the moment in env.locale (the year only when it is not this year; 12 or 24 hours as the device has it). The host redraws on its own while the node is on screen: elapsed every second, relative and short every minute (every 10 s in the first minute).

props.name: text
props.doc: The code. Past limits.maxCodeChars the host draws the start and a note.

props.name: language
props.doc: A language name (ts, tsx, js, json, rust, python, go, swift, kotlin, sh, yaml, toml, sql, md, diff…): the host colors what it knows with the app's code theme; diff colors the added, removed and hunk lines. null or unknown = plain.

props.name: startLine
props.doc: The number of the first line (an excerpt of a file).

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Lines to mark, numbered as shown (from startLine): [12, [20, 24]] marks 12 and 20 to 24.

props.name: wrap
props.doc: false: long lines scroll sideways, the whole block together.

props.name: value
props.doc: Formatted by the script (1.2k, 98.5%, 3/5).

props.name: unit
props.doc: Smaller, after the value (ms, GB).

props.name: hue
props.doc: The icon's and the series' color; none: the icon muted and the series blue.

props.name: delta
props.doc: A change, formatted (+12%, -3 today).

props.name: deltaTone
props.doc: The delta's color (success, danger); default = secondary.

props.name: detail
props.doc: One muted line under the value.

props.name: series
props.doc: Numbers for a sparkline under the value, at most limits.maxStatPoints (the host keeps the last); null entries are gaps.

props.name: series
props.doc: number[] (one series) or number[][] (one array per series, all the same length), at most limits.maxChartSeries series of limits.maxChartPoints points (the host keeps the last); null entries are gaps. Bars of several series stand side by side.

props.name: hues
props.doc: Hue names (enums.hue) per series; null or a missing entry = blue, purple, teal, green, amber, rose in turn.

props.name: labels
props.doc: One per point: the x labels (with axes the host shows the first, the last and what fits between) and the readout's title.

props.name: min
props.doc: The bottom of the y range; null = the data's lowest (0 for bars, and for area and line when no value is negative).

props.name: max
props.doc: The top of the y range; null = the data's highest.

props.name: thresholds
props.doc: Dashed horizontal lines: [{value, tone?, label?}], tone a tone name (warning, danger; default muted).

props.name: axes
props.doc: The y range's labels and the x labels; false = a bare chart.

props.name: unit
props.doc: After the y labels and the readout's values (ms, %).

props.name: legend
props.doc: Series names: a legend row under the chart, and the readout's names.

props.name: value
props.doc: 0..1, clamped.

props.name: text
props.doc: In the middle; null = the value as a whole percent (72%).

props.name: label
props.doc: Small and muted, under the text.

props.name: thresholds
props.doc: [warn] or [warn, danger], fractions ascending: at or past one the arc takes the warning, then the danger tone.

props.name: hue
props.doc: The arc's color under the thresholds; none = the accent.

props.name: size
props.doc: The width; a half gauge is about half as tall.

props.name: values
props.doc: Numbers >= 0, one per segment, at most limits.maxMeterSegments.

props.name: hues
props.doc: Hue names per segment; null or a missing entry = blue, purple, teal, green, amber, rose in turn.

props.name: labels
props.doc: One per segment: the legend and what a screen reader says.

props.name: max
props.doc: The bar's total; null = the sum of the values. What the values leave is the empty track.

props.name: legend
props.doc: A row under the bar: a dot, the label and the value of each segment.

props.name: items
props.doc: [{title, detail?, state?, progress?}], at most limits.maxStepsItems: state a stepState name (default pending); progress 0..1, a thin bar under an active step.

props.name: axis
props.doc: vertical: a rail of markers with the title and detail beside each. horizontal: markers joined by a line, the titles under them (scrolls sideways when they do not fit).

props.name: compact
props.doc: Titles only: no details and no progress.

props.name: peaks
props.doc: Numbers 0..1, one per bar, at most limits.maxWaveformPeaks; the host resamples them to the bars that fit its width.

props.name: progress
props.doc: 0..1: the played part in the hue, the rest muted, a playhead between; null = all in the hue, no playhead.

props.name: hue
props.doc: none = the accent.

props.name: markers
props.doc: Fractions 0..1: ticks over the bars (comments, chapters).

props.name: listFill
props.doc: Wide only: while showDetail is false the list takes the whole width (no detail column, no emptyDetail, no hide button); with showDetail the list has its usual width beside the detail.

icons.doc: The Lucide icons (ISC, lucide.dev) every host of this catalogue bundles, by kebab-case name: what icon props take. Appended to only; an older host may lack the newer names (it draws its neutral square).

remoteScreen.doc: The wire prop: function ids and argument templates. frames is {fn, args}: the host observes fn with those args (deliver output, max_in_flight 1, so a slow view drops frames) and paints each event; the other keys name the functions the host calls. Every fn must be in the app's own namespace. In args, a string value equal to a placeholder is replaced by the typed value; any other value is copied as is; a placeholder whose value is absent drops its key.

placeholders.$viewer: string: a viewer id, new on every activation: <connection browserId>-<node id>-<n> (the browserId starts with android-)
placeholders.$w: int: the view width in dp (page CSS px)
placeholders.$h: int: the view height in dp
placeholders.$seq: int: the last frame_seq painted (absent before the first)
placeholders.$x: float: page x (CSS px) of the gesture
placeholders.$y: float: page y (CSS px) of the gesture
placeholders.$count: int: click count (1, or 2 for the second tap of a double tap)
placeholders.$dx: float: horizontal scroll in CSS px (positive scrolls right)
placeholders.$dy: float: vertical scroll in CSS px (positive scrolls down)
placeholders.$key: string: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, Delete, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown

framePayload.frame: string: base64 JPEG, PNG or WebP (sniffed by magic bytes)
framePayload.width: int: page width the frame maps to (the input coordinate space)
framePayload.frame_seq: int: increases per frame of a session; a frame at or below the last painted is dropped
framePayload.session_id: string, optional: when present it must equal $session

vmToHost.name: set
vmToHost.doc: value null resets the prop to its default.

vmToHost.name: insert
vmToHost.doc: child must be detached; index 0..count of that slot.

vmToHost.name: move
vmToHost.doc: Moves one child within a slot; to is the index after removal.

vmToHost.name: remove
vmToHost.doc: Detaches the child at index; it stays alive until destroy or a new insert.

vmToHost.name: destroy
vmToHost.doc: Frees the node and every node still attached under it.

vmToHost.name: root
vmToHost.doc: The root node of a mounted page instance; id 0 clears it.

vmToHost.name: listSplice
vmToHost.doc: items: an array of JSON objects, each with its key field.

vmToHost.name: ready
vmToHost.doc: Once, when the bundle called defineApp: {sdk, catalog, features, pages: [{name, modal, fullScreen}]}.

hostToVm.name: init
hostToVm.doc: {catalog, features, host, engine, app: {key, ns}, env: Env}.

hostToVm.name: itemEvent
hostToVm.doc: An event of a template node, for the item with that key.

hostToVm.name: text
hostToVm.doc: TextField edit; count = the host's edits so far for that node. Only the last per node is kept within one message.

hostToVm.name: env
hostToVm.doc: Only the Env keys that changed.

hostToVm.name: mount
hostToVm.doc: page: a host-allocated page instance id, stable across VM restarts.

hostToVm.name: response
hostToVm.doc: ok 1: value is the result; ok 0: value is {code, message}.

hostToVm.name: observed
hostToVm.doc: A call of the function observed under sub: payload is its output (the event).

requests.name: on
requests.result: null once the observer is active
requests.doc: The host observes fn (a function of the app's namespace) with args and filters, deliver output, and sends each output as observed [9, sub, payload]; off disposes it.

requests.name: navPush
requests.result: {result: json|null} when the pushed card leaves

requests.name: toast
requests.result: null; with action, {action: bool} when the toast goes
requests.doc: With action, the toast shows it as a button and stays up longer (about 6 s); the host answers when the toast goes: {action: true} when the person tapped it, {action: false} when it timed out or was swiped away.

protocol.errorDoc: A failed request answers [8, reqId, 0, {code, message}]. Engine errors keep the engine's own code; the codes above are the host's.
